## Headline

I wrote notes/procedure.md and applied it to notes/a.md, notes/b.md, and notes/c.md, in that order. All three files now pass check_file.
- a.md had one banned word, "clearly". I deleted it.
- b.md had one long sentence. I split it into three.
- c.md had one banned word, "very", and one long sentence. I deleted the word and split the sentence.

## Background

The request asked for a procedure first, then a run of that procedure on three notes files. The procedure has 12 steps. It uses list_files, read_file, check_file, and write_file.

## Relevance

The files now meet the style limits of 25 words per sentence and no banned words. Any agent can reuse the procedure on other notes files.

## Information

Evidence from check_file, a tool run in this session [1]:

| File | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| notes/a.md | 1 banned word | 0 problems |
| notes/b.md | 1 long sentence | 0 problems |
| notes/c.md | 1 banned word, 1 long sentence | 0 problems |

Meaning check [judgment]: I kept every fact, number, and step order in each file.

Alternative considered: fix all three files in one pass without a re-check. This loses because the re-check in Step 9 of the procedure found no errors only after it ran.

## End

I recommend that we:

1. Keep notes/procedure.md as the standard method for note fixes.
   - Increment: add it to the team's notes index in one session.
   - Blocker removed: no shared method exists.
   - Test (evaluative). Rubric: clarity 50%, reuse by a new agent 50%, pass at 80%, evidence is one trial run on a new file.
   - Cynefin: Clear. A known rule applies by deduction.
2. Run check_file on every other notes file.
   - Increment: one run per file in one session.
   - Blocker removed: unknown state of other files.
   - Test (deterministic):
     Given a notes file
     When check_file runs on it
     Then the report lists zero long sentences and zero banned words
   - Cynefin: Clear. The tool applies a fixed rule by deduction.
3. Fix each failing file with the procedure. Step 3 MUST NOT start until Step 2 lists the failing files.
   - Increment: one file per cycle.
   - Blocker removed: style failures in notes.
   - Test (deterministic):
     Given a failing notes file
     When the agent follows the procedure
     Then check_file reports zero problems
   - Cynefin: Complicated. Analysis of each text picks the best rewrite.

## Follow-up

No open questions. The recommendation changes if check_file misses a rule, such as the grade limit. Then add a manual grade check to the procedure.

# Procedure: fix banned words and long sentences in one notes file

Use these steps on one file at a time. The tools are list_files, read_file, check_file, and write_file.

1. Call list_files. Confirm that the target file exists.
2. Call check_file on the target. Save the list of long sentences and banned words.
3. Call read_file on the target. Read the full text.
4. Write a new text. Split each sentence over 25 words into shorter sentences.
5. Replace each banned word with a plain word. If the word adds no meaning, delete it.
6. Keep every fact, number, name, and list item from the original text.
7. Do not add dashes. Use a comma, a colon, or a period instead.
8. Call write_file with the full new text. The tool replaces the old file.
9. Call check_file on the target again.
10. If check_file reports any problem, go to Step 4 and fix it. Repeat until the report is clean.
11. Compare the new text with the original. Confirm that the meaning is the same.
12. Move to the next file only after Step 11 passes.
